BASIC과 PRO의 차이는 무엇인가요?: What is the difference between BASIC and PRO?
두 플랜의 제공 내용은 동일합니다. 국내 상장 2,500여 개 종목의 리: Both plans offer the same content: full reports on over 2,500 stocks listed in Korea.
차이는 하루에 열람할 수 있는 종목 수입니다. BASIC은 5개, PRO: The difference is the number of stocks you can view per day: 5 on BASIC and 15 on PRO. BASIC suits investors who mainly follow the stocks they hold, and PRO suits those who compare and review many stocks.
You can change your plan at any time.
구독은 언제든지 해지할 수 있나요?: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
설정의 구독 항목에서 직접 해지하실 수 있으며, 별도의 전화나 문의 접수: You can cancel directly under Subscription in Settings; no phone call or inquiry is required. After you cancel, you keep access until the end of the period you have already paid for.
결제가 승인되지 않으면 어떻게 되나요?: What happens if a payment is declined?
등록하신 카드로 정기결제가 승인되지 않으면 유료 구간의 이용이 일시 중지: If a recurring payment on your registered card is declined, access to paid sections is suspended and the payment is retried automatically 1, 3, 5 and 7 days after the first decline. Once the payment goes through, a new one-month period starts from that point, so you are not charged for the time you could not use the service.
기다리지 않고 바로 재개하시려면 설정의 구독 항목에서 결제 수단을 다시: To resume right away, please register a payment method again under Subscription in Settings. If you do not want the retries, you can cancel in the same place, and the retries stop immediately. If all four retries are declined, the subscription ends automatically and nothing further is charged.
플랜을 중간에 바꾸면 어떻게 되나요?: What happens if I change plans mid-cycle?
BASIC에서 PRO로 변경하시면 신청 즉시 PRO가 적용됩니다. 이미: A change from BASIC to PRO takes effect immediately. The unused portion of your BASIC period is deducted from the PRO price, so you pay only the difference. Your monthly billing date stays the same.
변경 당일 이미 열람하신 리포트는 그대로 유지되며, 하루 열람 한도만 1: Reports you have already viewed that day still count; only the daily limit increases, to 15.
A change from PRO to BASIC takes effect from your next billing date. Until then, you continue to have PRO.
The basis depends on whether you have viewed any reports since payment.
리포트를 열람하지 않으신 경우: If you have not viewed any reports
결제 후 7일 이내 — 전액 환불: Within 7 days of payment — full refund
결제 후 7일 경과 — 잔여 이용 기간에 해당하는 금액에서 서비스 수수료: After 7 days — the amount for the remaining period is refunded, less a 10% service fee
이용하신 일수를 차감한 뒤, 서비스 수수료 10%를 제외한 금액이 환불됩: The days you have used are deducted, and the remainder is refunded less a 10% service fee.
신청하신 날은 어떻게 계산되나요?: How is the day of your request counted?
열람 한도는 하루 단위로 드리므로 차감도 하루 단위로 합니다. 신청하신: Because the viewing limit is granted per day, deductions are also made per day. If you viewed at least one report on the day of your request, that day counts as used and is deducted, and you can use the rest of that day's limit until midnight. If you viewed none, the day is not deducted and access ends as soon as you submit the request.
환불 신청은 설정의 구독 항목에서 직접 하실 수 있습니다. 개별 확인이: You can request a refund directly under Subscription in Settings. If your case needs individual review, please contact us.
하루 열람 한도는 어떻게 산정되나요?: How is the daily viewing limit calculated?
하루 동안 열람하신 종목의 수를 기준으로 산정합니다. 동일한 종목을 새로: It is based on the number of different stocks you view in a day. Refreshing the same stock or viewing it again on another device does not count again.
한도는 매일 자정(한국 시간)에 초기화됩니다. 무료로 공개되는 영역은 한: The limit resets every day at midnight Korea time. Free sections are available at any time regardless of the limit.
Market data such as share price, market cap and PER is updated every trading-day evening.
리포트 본문은 해당 기업이 DART에 사업보고서와 반기보고서, 분기보고서: When a company files an annual, half-year or quarterly report with DART, its report is automatically rewritten to reflect the latest results. Reports on newly listed stocks are written shortly after listing.
국내에서 발급된 신용카드와 체크카드로 결제하실 수 있습니다. 매달 결제일: You can pay with credit and debit cards issued in Korea. Payment is taken automatically on your billing date each month, and your payment history and receipts are available under Subscription in Settings.
구독하면 종목 추천을 받을 수 있나요?: Does a subscription include stock recommendations?
KOSAI는 자체 투자의견과 목표주가를 제시하지 않습니다. 구독 플랜에서: KOSAI does not issue its own investment ratings or price targets. What a subscription adds is analysis, outlook and risk assessment based on filings and financial results. Investment decisions and their outcomes remain the responsibility of the user.
The standards for writing reports are described on the About page.
KOSAI의 모든 분석·리포트는 투자 참고용 정보이며, 투자 권유나 추천: All KOSAI analysis and reports are provided for reference only and do not constitute a solicitation or recommendation to invest. Investment decisions and their outcomes remain the responsibility of the user.
표시 금액은 부가가치세가 포함된 가격입니다. 요금 변경 시 기존 구독자에: Prices shown include VAT. Existing subscribers will be notified in advance of any price change, and prices will not be raised without prior notice.
DART에 재무 정보가 공시되지 않는 일부 종목은 실적 표와 일부 분석: For some stocks whose financial information is not filed with DART, financial tables and some analysis sections are unavailable. Reports on these stocks are published in full, free of charge, regardless of subscription.
